mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and a temperature of 55 degrees at Harriet Park. We have a full moon tonight, and the ISS will be passing overhead, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

City officials are currently focused on the 2027 proposed annual budget. Additionally, the Plan Commission will meet on November 4th to review several local development projects, including the Ardent Glen addition and various site plans.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can head to Insight Wellness for yoga, and keep an eye out for the Main Street Trick or Treat event this Wednesday.
On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving. Alcohol was not a factor, and fortunately, no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Snickers Swirl. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
